# 00-intent — Intent

Why the project exists and who it is for: scope, goals, mission, boundaries, and the problem it solves.

Answers: "Why does this exist?" — vision, goal, requirements, design principles, success criteria.

Read when: you need the why before any other layer, or you are deciding whether a fact belongs here.

Boundary: holds the why only — not how it is built (Architecture, Implementation) or detailed capability requirements (Product).
